programs.name: pre-commit
programs.description: The pre-commit framework, which runs the commit gate in the git hooks. Any 4.x from uv tool install counts. A pre-commit from pipx or pip in the same bin folder stops the install: remove it first.

programs.name: commit-hooks
programs.install: uv tool run pre-commit install --hook-type pre-commit --hook-type pre-merge-commit --hook-type commit-msg --hook-type pre-push
programs.description: The git hooks pre-commit, pre-merge-commit and commit-msg, which run the commit gate, and pre-push, which runs just ci. When the check still fails, its message says why, for example a repo: local entry of the project that needs the hooks of the role.

before_remove.command: uv tool run pre-commit uninstall --hook-type pre-commit --hook-type pre-merge-commit --hook-type commit-msg --hook-type pre-push

installer_skill.name: gest_git_installer
installer_skill.description: After npx installs the skills, run the jnterfaces installer to add the Gest hooks, settings and AGENTS.md starter.

required.name: gest
required.install: Run `curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rahuldave/gest/v0.6.0/scripts/install.sh | sh -s -- --tag v0.6.0`, then put ~/.local/bin on PATH. To build it from source instead, git clone https://github.com/rahuldave/gest, run git checkout v0.6.0 in the clone, then run `cargo install --locked --path .` in the clone.
required.description: Tracks the tasks, specs and iterations of the g* skills. It must be the fork of rahuldave, whose gest --version prints (rahuldave). The gest of crates.io lacks the commands that the skills use.

required.name: jagt
required.install: Run `curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rahuldave/jagt/v0.6.4/scripts/install.sh | sh -s -- --tag v0.6.4`, then put ~/.local/bin on PATH. To build it from source instead, run `cargo install --locked --git https://github.com/rahuldave/jagt --tag v0.6.4 jagt`.
required.description: Renders the review packets of the tasker role and checks their results. Before 0.6.3, jagt can save the review packet where the commit gate does not read it, in a submodule or a linked worktree.
